note: FULL CONFIDENCE HEAD TRAINABLE AND ANCHORED, under the cross-seed softplus ranking loss. All 248 head tensors train (19.8M parameters, 4.3% of the model) with no --train-only; the anchor holds them near the shipped weights instead of freezing them. WHY: 24u34d plateaued with its held-out ranking loss at ~0.040 AND its training loss flat at the same value (0.04191 -> 0.04189 over epochs 6-7), both curves flattening together -- the signature of UNDERFITTING, so 44,032 parameters cannot express the correction the loss asks for. This is also the first full-head arm ever run under the ranking loss: all ~44 earlier ones used PAE (rank_form None). LAMBDA WAS MEASURED, NOT GUESSED, and that matters more here than in any previous arm: wpg274 ran this exact parameter set at l2_sp 1e-5 for 50 epochs under the PAE loss and ended at DockQ 0.1616 / frac 0.2778 against shipped 0.2909 / 0.5556, with drift at 3,801 and the penalty at 1.9% of the loss -- the anchor was not binding and the head moved freely to a much worse place. The sqrt factor alone (40,960 -> 19.84M anchored, 22.0x) would put lambda at 1.1e-5, to one digit that same failed value; it is not necessarily the same setting, because the ranking gradient is ~25x smaller than the PAE gradient (alignment probes: ||sum_i g_i|| 1.4e-2 rank vs 3.6e-1 PAE at the same weights), so the same lambda is ~25x more binding against this objective -- but that factor was measured by a fresh --grad-probe at this trainable set rather than assumed. The 4 zero-init orientation tensors stay OUT of the anchor via --l2-sp-exclude 'frame_dir', since anchoring a zero-init tensor to zero is plain decay on the new term. EVERYTHING ELSE MATCHES 24u34d so capacity is the only variable: tau 0.0305, --alpha-pae 0, distance AND orientation at all four pairformer blocks, overfit30 train, val10 held out every epoch at budget 30, 50 epochs, 100 poses/step, 15 steps/epoch, lr 1e-2, warmup 20, --blocks-per-ckpt 0. CRITERION: selected DockQ and fraction above 0.23 on the 18 val10 interfaces against shipped (DockQ 0.2909, frac 0.5556, oracle 0.5968/1.0000). Spearman is reported but is NOT the criterion. THE RISK, STATED: 19.8M parameters against 30 training structures, and wpg274 is what this looks like when the anchor is too loose -- watch drift and the metrics together from epoch 1, not just the loss. CONTROLS: 24u34d (same arm, 44,032 parameters), wpg274 (same parameter set, loose anchor, PAE loss).
